ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (FEES FOR INSPECTION OF MOTOR VEHICLES

SERVICES) RULES 2016

IN exercise of powers conferred by paragraph 126(2)(a) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Road Transport (Fees for Inspection of

Motor Vehicles Services) Rules 2016.

(2) These Rules are deemed to have come into operation on 1 September 2009.

Fees

2. The fees for inspection of motor vehicles services payable to the person authorized

or licensed under subsection 126(1) of the Act are as prescribed in the Schedule.
